project.description: 150 kW rooftop solar system on a warehouse in Windsor, Ontario

mandatory.label: Ontario electrical contractor licence
mandatory.admin_guidance: Licence must be held by the bidder itself (not a subcontractor) and stated in the proposal, ideally with a licence number.

mandatory.label: WSIB clearance and $5M liability insurance
mandatory.admin_guidance: Both WSIB clearance and liability insurance of at least $5M must be confirmed.

weighted.label: Relevant experience
weighted.admin_guidance: Count of commercial installations of 100 kW or more completed in the last 5 years.

weighted.label: Price
weighted.admin_guidance: Total all-in price in CAD. Lower is better; above the ceiling is ineligible.

weighted.label: Timeline
weighted.admin_guidance: Committed completion time in weeks from award. Shorter is better; over 16 weeks is ineligible.

weighted.label: Warranty
weighted.admin_guidance: Length of panel warranty and workmanship warranty, in years. Each counts for half.

weighted.label: Team and approach
weighted.admin_guidance: Named project lead, a described crew, a site safety plan, and a post-installation performance monitoring plan. Each item counts for a quarter.

licence_held_by_bidder.question: Does the bidder itself (not a subcontractor) state that it holds an Ontario electrical contractor licence?

wsib_clearance.question: Does the proposal confirm current WSIB clearance?

liability_insurance_5m.question: Does the proposal confirm liability insurance of at least $5M?

qualifying_installs_count.question: How many commercial solar installations of 100 kW or more does the bidder say it completed? Also report the earliest year the count covers.

total_price_cad.question: What is the total price in CAD?

completion_weeks.question: How many weeks from award does the bidder commit to for completion?

panel_warranty_years.question: How many years is the panel warranty?

workmanship_warranty_years.question: How many years is the workmanship warranty?

named_project_lead.question: Does the proposal commit a named or specifically identified project lead / manager (not one 'to be assigned later')?

crew_described.question: Does the proposal describe the installation crew (size and/or qualifications)?

safety_plan.question: Does the proposal include a site safety plan?

performance_monitoring_plan.question: Does the proposal include monitoring of the system's performance after installation (not just project progress reporting)?
